spans.s:
f. (-जूः)
1 Speed, velocity.
2 Motion in general.
E.
ज्वर to make haste, affix क्विप्, and उठ् substituted for ब.

(इ) जुर्वी r. 1st cl. (जूर्वति)
To hurt or kill.

(ई) जूरी r. 4th cl. (जूर्य्यते)
1 To hurt, to injure, to world or kill.
2 To be decayed, to decay or grow old.

m. (-यः)
A kind of grain, (Andropogon sorghum): see देवधान्य.

Fever.
E.
ज्वर to be feverish, Uṇādi affix नि.

f. (-र्त्तिः)
Fever, feverish or morbid heat.
E.
ज्वर to be feverish, क्तिन् aff.
